summary.text: Andrea Hunley is a Democratic member of the Indiana Senate for District 46, which includes downtown Indianapolis, Irvington, Fountain Square and Garfield Park.
The caucus page lists Hunley as Assistant Minority Leader.

paragraphs.text: Hunley holds a bachelor's degree in secondary education and a master's degree in language education from Indiana University, and the page lists her field as education and school administration.

The page lists Hunley as chaplain of the Indiana Black Legislative Caucus and a 2023 Bowhay Fellow of the Council of State Governments' Legislative Leadership Development program, and says she lives in Indianapolis with her husband and two children.

sources.title: State Senator Andrea Hunley (Indiana Senate Democrats)
